problem: Choose a column type for order amounts in a new billing service
context: PostgreSQL. Amounts are in currencies with at most 2 decimal places. Totals, taxes and refunds are summed and compared exactly.
constraints: Sums and comparisons of amounts must be exact

options.summary: double precision column holding the amount in major units, e.g. 19.99
numeric(12,2) column holding the amount in major units
bigint column holding the amount in minor units (cents), e.g. 1999

criteria.description: Exact arithmetic with no rounding surprises
Easy to use correctly in application code

expected.why: Floating point can't represent most decimal amounts exactly; both exact types are standard.
